name: Billomat Invoicing
description: Manage invoices, clients, articles, and accounting with Billomat. German online invoicing and bookkeeping platform for freelancers and SMBs.
instructions:
Billomat is a German online invoicing and bookkeeping service. This connector reads clients, invoices, offers (estimates, Angebote) and articles through the Billomat REST API. Every tool is read-only.

**Getting credentials**
1. API access is switched on per user: in Billomat open **Settings → Employees** (Einstellungen → Mitarbeiter), edit the user and activate API access. Billomat then generates a personal API key; copy it into `BILLOMAT_API_KEY`. The key acts with that user's rights.
2. Set `BILLOMAT_SUBDOMAIN` to your Billomat ID, the first part of your account address: for `mycompany.billomat.net`, enter `mycompany`. Requests go to `https://mycompany.billomat.net/api` with the key in the `X-BillomatApiKey` header.

**Finding records**: get tools take Billomat's internal numeric `id`, not the document number (`RE123`) or client number (`KD123`). List clients first (`name` matches part of the name, case-insensitive) and pass their `id` as `client_id` to filter invoices and offers.

**Status values**: invoices are `DRAFT`, `OPEN`, `OVERDUE`, `PAID` or `CANCELED`; several can be combined with commas, e.g. `OPEN,OVERDUE` for everything unpaid. Offers are `DRAFT`, `OPEN`, `WON`, `LOST`, `CANCELED` or `CLEARED`. Booleans are `1` and `0`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD`, timestamps ISO 8601 with offset.

**Reading responses**: lists are wrapped, e.g. `{"invoices": {"invoice": [...], "@page": "1", "@per_page": "100", "@total": "57"}}`. When exactly one record matches, `invoice` can be a single object instead of an array. `billomat_get_invoice` returns the header with `total_net`, `total_gross`, `taxes`, `paid_amount` and `open_amount`; line items, comments and payments are separate Billomat resources that this adapter does not read.

**Pagination and limits**: `page` starts at 1; `per_page` defaults to 100 and allows up to 1000. Keep paging while `page` × `per_page` is below `@total`. Billomat allows 300 requests per account per 15-minute window (XX:00, XX:15, XX:30, XX:45) for clients that are not registered as an app, and this adapter is not; the quota is shared with every other unregistered integration on the account. Over the quota, Billomat answers HTTP 429 and says how many seconds to wait.

**Cloud reachability**: `*.billomat.net` is publicly reachable over HTTPS.

tools.name: billomat_list_clients
tools.description: List clients from Billomat. Returns client name, number, address, email, and payment terms.

tools.name: billomat_get_client
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific client by ID.

tools.name: billomat_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices from Billomat. Returns invoice number, date, total, status, and client info.

status.description: Filter by status: DRAFT, OPEN, OVERDUE, PAID, CANCELED

tools.name: billomat_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its internal ID: number, status, dates, client, net and gross totals, taxes, paid and open amount. Line items, comments and payments are separate Billomat resources and are not included.

tools.name: billomat_list_articles
tools.description: List articles (products/services) from Billomat. Returns article number, title, unit price, and tax info.

tools.name: billomat_list_offers
tools.description: List offers (quotes) from Billomat. Returns offer number, date, total, status, and client info.
